strings.zh: 哎呀,我的老公好像很忙啊,{NEWLINE}身体没什么问题吧？{SCROLL}他一碰到精灵的研究{NEWLINE}就专心得连饭也顾不上吃！
strings.en: Oh my, my husband seems awfully busy.{NEWLINE}His health is holding up, isn’t it?{SCROLL}Once he gets into his Pokémon research,{NEWLINE}he’s so focused he forgets to eat!
strings.notes: US 0544/0 | seed rejected us [tag_mismatch] (candidate US 0544#0; text not kept) | RV053: meaning: 身体没什么问题吧？ is about his health

strings.zh: 空木博士特地从城都地区{NEWLINE}抓了三只非常稀有的口袋妖怪{CLEAR}作为赠送给图鉴所有者的初始精灵。{SCROLL}你想知道它们分别是从哪里抓的吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Professor Elm caught three very rare{NEWLINE}Johto Pokémon himself.{SCROLL}They’re first partners for his Pokédex{NEWLINE}holders.{SCROLL}Would you like to know where each one{NEWLINE}was caught?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 想知道的话随时可以来问我。
strings.en: If you ever want to know, just ask me.

strings.zh: 我儿子阿金总嚷嚷着{NEWLINE}要成为最强的训练家。{CLEAR}虽然我也知道这条路并不好走,{CLEAR}但既然孩子这么执着又努力,{CLEAR}我又怎能不支持呢。
strings.en: My son Gold is always going on about{NEWLINE}becoming the strongest Trainer.{SCROLL}I know it’s not an easy road, but when{NEWLINE}my boy is that determined and works{CLEAR}that hard, how could I not support him?

strings.zh: 我儿子阿金今天就要外出旅行了。{SCROLL}看到这孩子迈出独立成长的第一步,{NEWLINE}我真的非常欣慰。
strings.en: My son Gold is setting off on his journey{NEWLINE}today.{SCROLL}Seeing him take his first step toward{NEWLINE}standing on his own makes me so happy.

strings.zh: 长太郎『Aiii——po！
strings.en: Aibo: Aiii-po!

strings.en: Chikorita

strings.zh: 我不想知道
strings.en: No, thanks

strings.zh: 菊草叶是在桐树林捉到的,{NEWLINE}那里是茂密的森林,{CLEAR}生活着各种类型的草系精灵呢。
strings.en: Chikorita was caught in Ilex Forest.{SCROLL}It’s a dense forest where all kinds of{NEWLINE}Grass-type Pokémon live.

strings.zh: 火球鼠是在47号路的山洞捉到的,{NEWLINE}博士为了去那儿走了好远的路。
strings.en: Cyndaquil was caught in the cave on{NEWLINE}Route 47.{SCROLL}The Professor walked a long way to get{NEWLINE}there.

strings.zh: 小锯鳄是在愤怒湖捉到的,{NEWLINE}我记得当时湖里有很多鲤鱼王呢。
strings.en: Totodile was caught at the Lake of{NEWLINE}Rage.{SCROLL}I remember the lake was full of Magikarp{NEWLINE}back then.

strings.zh: 皮皮是进化了的精灵。{NEWLINE}这个假说最早是由空木博士提出的。{CLEAR}后来随着城都地区发现了皮宝宝,{CLEAR}空木博士的假说才得以证实。
strings.en: Professor Elm was the first to suggest{NEWLINE}that Clefairy is an evolved Pokémon.{SCROLL}When Cleffa was later discovered in{NEWLINE}Johto, his theory was proven.

strings.zh: 皮宝宝『Cleee——fa！
strings.en: Cleffa: Cleee-fa!

strings.zh: 你好,这里是专门接待{NEWLINE}过往训练家的若叶镇民宿。{CLEAR}请问有什么可以帮您的吗？
strings.en: Hello, and welcome to the New Bark{NEWLINE}Guesthouse, where Trainers passing{CLEAR}through can stay.{SCROLL}How can I help you?

strings.zh: 休息一下　500元
strings.en: Rest ($500)
strings.notes: Menu item; zh separates label and price with a full-width space.

strings.zh: 吃点东西
strings.en: Something to eat

strings.zh: 没事了
strings.en: Never mind

strings.zh: 好的,休息请您移步楼上。
strings.en: Certainly. Please go upstairs to rest.

strings.zh: 您身上带的钱好像不够啊。
strings.en: I’m afraid you don’t have enough money.

strings.zh: 您想来点什么呢？
strings.en: What would you like?

strings.zh: 树果汁{NEWLINE}100元
strings.en: Berry Juice{NEWLINE}$100

strings.zh: 月见山泉水{NEWLINE}2000元
strings.en: Fresh Water{NEWLINE}$2000

strings.zh: 橘果{NEWLINE}100元
strings.en: Oran Berry{NEWLINE}$100

strings.zh: 大树果{NEWLINE}1000元
strings.en: Sitrus Berry{NEWLINE}$1000

strings.zh: 不买了
strings.en: Nothing, thanks

strings.zh: 来,您要的东西,请拿好。
strings.en: Here you are. Enjoy!

strings.zh: 欢迎光临若叶镇民宿。{NEWLINE}二楼是娱乐和休息的地方,{CLEAR}您在这里放松尽情放松就好。
strings.en: Welcome to the New Bark Guesthouse.{SCROLL}The second floor is for fun and{NEWLINE}relaxation.{SCROLL}Please make yourself at home.

strings.zh: 一台连着网的电脑。
strings.en: A PC connected to the Internet.

strings.zh: 最新款的Switch,{NEWLINE}但因为是破解版,{CLEAR}所以没有卡带！
strings.en: The latest Switch! But it’s a hacked{NEWLINE}one, so there aren’t any game cards!

strings.zh: 我从神奥地区到这里,{NEWLINE}一路上非常劳累。{CLEAR}幸好有这间民宿可以休息,{CLEAR}等我养足精力后{CLEAR}就去会会石英高原附近的高手。
strings.en: I came all the way here from Sinnoh, and{NEWLINE}the trip wore me out.{SCROLL}Good thing this guesthouse was here.{SCROLL}Once I’ve got my strength back, I’ll go{NEWLINE}take on the strong Trainers near the{CLEAR}Indigo Plateau.

strings.zh: 你知道我身边的这只精灵是什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Do you know what this Pokémon next to{NEWLINE}me is?{SCROLL}

strings.en: No idea

strings.en: Looks like you need to broaden your{NEWLINE}knowledge a bit.

strings.zh: 不对哦,你可以好好想想再回答。
strings.en: Nope, that’s not it. Think it over and{NEWLINE}try again.

strings.zh: 哇哦！想不到你对{NEWLINE}神奥地区的精灵也这么了解。{SCROLL}正好我的这只电光狮{NEWLINE}在满金市的饲育屋{CLEAR}孵化了一只小电狮,{CLEAR}如果你不嫌弃的话{CLEAR}请带上这只小电狮旅行吧,{CLEAR}它一定会成为你的得力助手。{SCROLL}要带上小电狮一起旅行吗？
strings.en: Wow! I didn’t expect you to know Sinnoh{NEWLINE}Pokémon so well.{SCROLL}As it happens, my Luxray had a Shinx{NEWLINE}hatch at the Goldenrod City Day Care.{SCROLL}If you don’t mind, please take this{NEWLINE}Shinx along on your journey.{SCROLL}I’m sure it’ll be a great help to you.{SCROLL}Will you take Shinx with you?

strings.en: Luxray: Lax-ray!

strings.zh: 唉,阿金这小子出去旅行之后,{NEWLINE}就没人陪我打台球了。
strings.en: Sigh...{SCROLL}Now that Gold’s gone off on his journey,{NEWLINE}I’ve got nobody to play pool with.

strings.zh: 我将来也要像阿金哥哥那样{NEWLINE}走遍城都地区、收集道馆徽章！
strings.en: When I grow up, I’ll travel all over{NEWLINE}Johto collecting Gym Badges, like Gold!

strings.zh: 我听说阿金哥哥被空木博士选中,{NEWLINE}要出去旅行了。{CLEAR}等我将来长大了,{CLEAR}我也要像阿金哥哥那样出去旅行！
strings.en: I heard Gold was chosen by Professor{NEWLINE}Elm and is going on a journey.{SCROLL}When I’m older, I’m going on a journey{NEWLINE}just like him!

strings.zh: 阿金这小子虽然调皮,{NEWLINE}头脑倒是很灵光。{SCROLL}也难怪空木博士{NEWLINE}会选中他帮自己做研究。
strings.en: Gold may be a little rascal, but he’s{NEWLINE}sharp as a tack.{SCROLL}No wonder Professor Elm picked him to{NEWLINE}help with his research.

strings.zh: 我对精灵的情绪非常敏感,{NEWLINE}如果你想知道你和精灵之间的亲密度,{CLEAR}我可以帮你看看哦。{SCROLL}需要让阿姨帮你看看亲密度吗？
strings.en: I’m very sensitive to how Pokémon feel.{SCROLL}If you want to know how close you are{NEWLINE}to your Pokémon, I can take a look.{SCROLL}Shall Auntie check its friendship for{NEWLINE}you?

strings.zh: 想看的话随时来找我。
strings.en: Come see me anytime you want to know.

strings.zh: 要看哪个精灵的亲密度呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Which Pokémon should I check?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 蛋状态下是没有亲密度的。
strings.en: An Egg doesn’t have any friendship yet.

strings.zh: {VAR:0100:0}跟你亲密到了{NEWLINE}无以复加的程度！{CLEAR}你就是它心中最完美的训练家！
strings.en: {VAR:0100:0} couldn’t possibly be any{NEWLINE}closer to you!{SCROLL}You’re its perfect Trainer!

strings.zh: {VAR:0100:0}非常喜欢你。{NEWLINE}如果你再努努力的话,{CLEAR}你们会更加亲密。
strings.en: {VAR:0100:0} likes you a lot. If you keep{NEWLINE}at it, you’ll become even closer.

strings.zh: {VAR:0100:0}跟你的关系还不错。{NEWLINE}但依然有很大的提升空间。
strings.en: {VAR:0100:0} gets along with you pretty{NEWLINE}well.{SCROLL}But there’s still plenty of room to{NEWLINE}grow.

strings.zh: {VAR:0100:0}对你还有些生疏,{NEWLINE}你要好好培养你们之间的感情啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0100:0} is still a little distant with{NEWLINE}you. Work on building your bond.
